{"subject":"Recap: Calder Bank technical validation, September 29","body":"Hi Gregor and Tamsin,

Thanks for your time today. Here is what we covered.

Shown on your sample data: column level lineage for the loan book model, a masking policy on borrower name and national ID, and the warehouse connector, which syncs continuously at about a minute end to end.

Open items:
- Stored procedures: Tamsin, most of yours are dynamic, so Sofia will try to run a couple through our parser. No timing is promised yet. Sofia will send you a short write-up of what she needs from you.
- Data dictionary: Gregor, you will try to find it so we can scope the full model. If a partial export is easier, tell us and we will size the request.

No next meeting is set. Gregor, you will ping me once the quarter close is clearer, and I will wait for your note.
